name: Champagne Vinegar
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated on SIBO diets as vinegars are FODMAP-free and may help with digestion.
preparationTips: Use in salad dressings with low-FODMAP oils
Add to marinades for proteins and vegetables
Mix with herbs like chives or basil for flavor enhancement
Store in a cool, dark place to maintain quality
pairsWellWith: Fresh herbs like basil and oregano
nutritionalHighlights: Very low in calories (about 3 per tablespoon)
May help with blood sugar management
Adds flavor without sodium when used in place of salt
